feeds.title: 38 North
feeds.description: 38 North provides an informed analysis of events in and around North Korea. It is intended to provide high-quality research, analysis and commentary on a broad range of topics related to North Korea. While it strives to break new ground, the site's main objective is to bring the best possible analysis to both seasoned North Korea watchers and general audiences alike.

feeds.title: North Korea Times
feeds.description: North Korea Times is a Pyongyang-focused online newspaper that seeks to present full and frank coverage of one of the world's most watched countries. Our mission is to provide up-to-the-minute news about the country, together with international headlines as part of a global network pooling resources to deliver a quality service to member portals. It presents breaking local news, the top stories, business headlines, and North Korean weather.
